framework_lessons: Distinguish gross financing, net saving, valuation changes and hedging.
assessment: The defensive February positioning and subsequent negotiation expectation receive support. The reserve-dollar explanation overstates the necessity of trade deficits, and NIIP valuation effects materially complicate its ownership narrative. The April outflow diagnosis has some evidence but omits FX hedging. Explicit multi-year rotation, ITUB and gold horizons remain unfinished; the AMD option outcome is conditional on execution.
